name: Sagara Nagisa
source: An Iga ninja who escaped from her village in order to meet with her lover, Koshirou. Speaks rather bluntly for a ninja who is trained in the old-fashioned way.
translation: An Iga ninja who escaped from her village in order to meet with her lover, Koshirou. Speaks rather bluntly for a ninja who is trained in the old-fashioned way.
